items.title: 美債買家不再照單全收！30年期殖利率恐長期卡在高檔
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Buyers No Longer Take Everything; 30‑Year Yield May Stay Stuck High
paras: 美國 30 年期公債殖利率徘徊數十年高點，巴克萊 (Barclays)(BCS-US) 認為，除了通膨與財政赤字疑慮，美債買方結構由央行等官方機構轉向共同基金、家庭及其他民間投資人，也是推升長債殖利率的重要力量。這些買家更在意投資報酬，在通膨持續偏高之際，將要求更高的殖利率才願意承接長天期美債。
巴克萊策略師 Demi Hu 與 Anshul Pradan 在報告中指出，自 Fed 於 2022 年開始縮減資產負債表以來，Fed 與外國央行對美債的官方需求逐漸減弱，民間投資人因此成為吸收新增供給的邊際買家。
巴克萊估計，民間投資人目前持有約 73% 的美債，遠高於十年前的約 50%。該行依不同投資人持債比重編製的需求彈性指數顯示，過去十年間，美債市場已明顯更加依賴對價格敏感的買家。
與基於政策目標購買美債的 Fed 及外國央行不同，共同基金、外國民間投資人、銀行與家庭在配置資產時，更重視預期報酬。隨著這類買家占比提高，美國財政部可能必須提供結構性更高的「期限溢價」，才能吸引投資人承擔持有長債的利率與通膨風險。
美國通膨過去五年持續高於 Fed 目標，加上 2020 年疫情以來財政赤字擴大，使投資人更加關注政府舉債規模、長天期債券供給及通膨風險。巴克萊指出，即使美債發行量相同，在市場更加依賴價格敏感型買家的情況下，也可能需要更大幅度的殖利率讓步才能順利消化供給。
美國 30 年期公債殖利率周二 (11 日) 約為 5.23%，稍早一度逼近 5.28% 的數十年高點。自今年稍早突破 5% 以來，截至周二已有 41 個交易日維持在此水準之上，創 2007 年全年曾連續 50 天高於 5% 以來最長紀錄。
市場除等待本周公布的美國通膨數據，也將迎接周四 (13 日)250 億美元 30 年期新債標售，得標殖利率料創 2001 年 8 月以來最高。今年以來，追蹤 20 年以上美債的彭博指數已下跌 3.8%，逆轉 2025 年上漲 4.6% 的表現。
超長天期美債主要由需要匹配數十年負債的保險公司及退休基金承接，但 20 年期與 30 年期債券的固定利率更容易遭高通膨侵蝕。巴克萊警告，只要民間投資人繼續成為美債主要買家，長債期限溢價就可能回升至全球金融危機前的水準，使長期殖利率維持高檔。
paras_en: U.S. 30‑year Treasury yields are hovering near multi‑decade highs, and Barclays (Barclays) (BCS‑US) says that beyond inflation and fiscal‑deficit concerns, the buyer base for U.S. Treasuries has shifted from central banks and other official institutions to mutual funds, households and other private investors, which is a key driver of higher long‑term yields. These buyers care more about investment returns and, with inflation still elevated, will demand higher yields before they are willing to take on long‑dated U.S. debt.

Barclays strategists Demi Hu and Anshul Pradan note in their report that since the Fed began shrinking its balance sheet in 2022, official demand for Treasuries from the Fed and foreign central banks has gradually waned, leaving private investors to become the marginal buyers absorbing new supply.

Barclays estimates that private investors now hold about 73% of U.S. Treasuries, far above the roughly 50% share a decade ago. The bank’s demand‑elasticity index, which is weighted by investor holdings, shows that over the past ten years the Treasury market has become markedly more dependent on price‑sensitive buyers.

Unlike the Fed and foreign central banks, which buy Treasuries for policy reasons, mutual funds, foreign private investors, banks and households focus on expected returns when allocating assets. As the share of these buyers grows, the U.S. Treasury may have to offer a structurally higher term premium to entice investors to bear the interest‑rate and inflation risk of long‑dated bonds.

U.S. inflation has run above the Fed’s target for the past five years, and the fiscal deficit has expanded since the 2020 pandemic, prompting investors to scrutinize the government’s borrowing scale, long‑term supply and inflation risk. Barclays points out that even with the same issuance volume, a market that relies more on price‑sensitive buyers may require a larger yield concession to absorb supply smoothly.

The U.S. 30‑year Treasury yield was about 5.23% on Tuesday (the 11th), briefly edging toward the multi‑decade high of 5.28%. Since breaking above 5% earlier this year, the yield has stayed above that level for 41 trading days as of Tuesday, the longest stretch since 2007 when it stayed above 5% for 50 consecutive days.

Markets are awaiting this week’s U.S. inflation data and are also gearing up for the $25 billion 30‑year new‑issue auction on Thursday (the 13th), with the winning yield expected to be the highest since August 2001. So far this year, Bloomberg’s index tracking Treasuries with maturities over 20 years has fallen 3.8%, reversing a 4.6% gain recorded in 2025.

Ultra‑long‑dated Treasuries are mainly bought by insurers and pension funds that need to match multi‑decade liabilities, but the fixed rates on 20‑year and 30‑year bonds are more vulnerable to erosion by high inflation. Barclays warns that as long as private investors remain the primary buyers of Treasuries, the term premium on long bonds could rebound to pre‑global‑financial‑crisis levels, keeping long‑term yields elevated.

items.title: 5000億美元不是輝達全扛！黃仁勳劃清責任界線 信用風險回落
items.title_en: $500 B Not Fully Shouldered by Nvidia! Jensen Huang Draws Clear Responsibility Line, Credit Risk Falls
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳進一步說明規模達 5,000 億美元的人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設融資計畫，強調輝達對個別項目的支持最多僅占 25%，且不會取代金融機構的獨立風險審查。相關說明緩解債券投資人對輝達可能承擔過高財務風險的疑慮，帶動公司信用風險指標周二 (11 日) 回落。
輝達票面利率 5.625%、2056 年到期的公司債，殖利率與同期美國公債的利差收窄 2 個基點至 113 個基點。與此同時，輝達五年期信用違約交換 (CDS) 價格一度收窄 5 個基點，降至每年 72.11 個基點，反映市場認為公司違約風險有所降低。
這項融資計畫預計動員最高 5,000 億美元資金，用於興建帶動輝達晶片需求的 AI 基礎設施。然而，先前相關報導及周一晚間的初步公告，並未清楚交代計畫時程、融資架構，以及輝達實際需要承擔多少資金與風險，導致投資人急於評估其潛在影響。
Coherence Credit Strategies 投資長 Sal Naro 表示，市場起初並不清楚 5,000 億美元融資計畫代表什麼，如今可以確定輝達將引入多家金融機構共同參與，公司自身承擔的風險並沒有投資人最初擔心的嚴重。
黃仁勳在社群平台 X 發文表示，輝達將逐案審慎評估投資機會，對單一項目的支持最高為 25%。他強調，相關支持規模有限，並以專案剩餘價值作為基礎，目的是補充而非取代金融機構的獨立承銷與風險評估。
參與計畫的金融機構包括阿波羅全球管理、黑石、貝萊德、布魯克菲爾德資產管理、高盛及 KKR。黃仁勳的說明降低計畫的不確定性，也舒緩市場對輝達可能為 AI 支出提供大規模擔保或直接融資的擔憂。
輝達與其他科技巨頭近來以前所未見的速度進入美國投資級債券市場，為 AI 計畫籌措資金。不過，市場也擔心，AI 晶片需求高度依賴大型科技公司以舉債方式擴大資本支出，一旦這些企業未來縮減投資，輝達銷售成長可能受到衝擊。
此外，輝達已與多家 AI 公司簽署大型晶片採購及投資協議，引發外界質疑，這類相互投資與採購的「循環交易」可能同時墊高晶片需求及 AI 產業估值。儘管黃仁勳的最新說明暫時安撫債市，投資人仍將密切關注計畫的具體融資結構與輝達最終承擔的實際風險。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang further explained the AI infrastructure financing plan worth up to $500 billion, stressing that Nvidia’s support for any individual project will be no more than 25% and will not replace independent risk reviews by financial institutions. The clarification eased bond investors’ concerns that Nvidia might bear excessive financial risk, causing the company’s credit‑risk metrics to retreat on Tuesday (the 11th).

Nvidia’s 5.625% senior notes due 2056 saw the yield spread over comparable U.S. Treasuries narrow by 2 basis points to 113 bps. At the same time, Nvidia’s five‑year credit‑default swap (CDS) price briefly tightened by 5 bps, falling to 72.11 bps per annum, reflecting the market’s view that the firm’s default risk has lessened.

The financing plan is expected to mobilise up to $500 billion to build AI infrastructure that will drive demand for Nvidia chips. However, earlier reports and a preliminary announcement on Monday night did not clearly outline the timeline, financing structure, or how much capital and risk Nvidia would actually assume, leaving investors scrambling to assess the potential impact.

Sal Naro, CIO of Coherence Credit Strategies, said the market initially did not understand what the $500 billion financing plan represented; it is now clear that Nvidia will bring in multiple financial institutions to participate, and the risk the company itself bears is not as severe as investors first feared.

Jensen Huang posted on X that Nvidia will evaluate investment opportunities on a case‑by‑case basis, with support for any single project capped at 25%. He emphasized that the support is limited in scale and based on the project’s residual value, intended to supplement—not replace—financial institutions’ independent underwriting and risk assessment.

Participating financial institutions include Apollo Global Management, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield Asset Management, Goldman Sachs and KKR. Huang’s clarification reduced the plan’s uncertainty and eased market worries that Nvidia might provide large‑scale guarantees or direct financing for AI spending.

Nvidia, along with other tech giants, has recently entered the U.S. investment‑grade bond market at an unprecedented pace to raise capital for AI projects. Yet the market worries that AI chip demand is heavily dependent on large tech firms borrowing to expand capex; if those firms cut back investment, Nvidia’s sales growth could be hit.

Moreover, Nvidia has signed large chip‑purchase and investment agreements with several AI companies, prompting concerns that such reciprocal deals could simultaneously inflate chip demand and AI industry valuations. Although Huang’s latest remarks have temporarily soothed the bond market, investors will continue to closely monitor the concrete financing structure of the plan and the actual risk Nvidia ultimately assumes.

items.title: 還沒達到2%就想換指標？華許政策框架恐賠上Fed公信力
items.title_en: Want to Change the Indicator Before Hitting 2%? Warsh's Policy Framework May Undermine Fed Credibility
paras: 美國聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 上任後開局不順，不僅拒絕說明經濟前景改變時將如何調整貨幣政策，他對通膨目標與政策框架的模糊表態，也正侵蝕 Fed 的公信力。《彭博》專欄指出，取消前瞻指引或許有其道理，但若 Fed 反過來依賴金融市場判斷政策方向，將形成央行與市場互相等待訊號的困局，最終只會增加不確定性、推高風險溢價，並削弱政策可信度。
華許面臨的問題並非只是溝通技巧不佳，更在於他始終沒有清楚說明自己如何理解通膨，以及貨幣政策究竟透過何種管道影響物價。

PCE 地位可能動搖 2% 目標可信度受考驗

華許在 7 月底記者會暗示，Fed 最快可能在明年 1 月後，不再把個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE) 當作主要通膨衡量標準。他當時表示，明年 1 月後 Fed 將如何描述政策策略仍未可知，相關專案小組或許會提出新看法。
華許並援引「盧卡斯批判」與「古德哈特定律」，說明一項通膨指標一旦被正式設定為政策目標，其衡量效果可能隨經濟行為改變而降低。前者意指經濟政策改變後，民眾與企業也會調整行為，使過去觀察到的規律不再可靠；後者則指出，一項指標成為政策目標後，往往就不再是良好的衡量指標。
不過，專欄認為，在 Fed 尚未實現 PCE 年增 2% 的既定目標前，就暗示可能更換主要通膨指標，形同在抵達終點前移動球門，難以強化外界對 Fed 維護物價穩定承諾的信心。
華許也未清楚說明通膨的主要驅動因素。舉例而言，剔除短期供需衝擊後的基礎通膨，究竟源於勞動力供給無法滿足需求，還是與 Fed 資產負債表規模、貨幣供給成長及金融體系流動性有關，目前仍不得而知。
華許似乎對傳統菲利普曲線框架抱持懷疑。該理論認為，勞動市場過熱將推升工資與通膨，但華許強調，物價穩定與高就業並非必然互相衝突。儘管他承認通膨預期十分重要，卻未解釋預期如何形成，以及 Fed 政策如何影響預期。若政策框架僅剩「通膨取決於預期、預期取決於 Fed 可信度」，卻未納入總體供給與需求，恐難以令人信服。

縮表換降息論述 模糊貨幣政策傳導機制

華許似乎更加重視 Fed 資產負債表及廣義貨幣供給的成長。Fed 最新提交國會的貨幣政策報告，也特別提到廣義貨幣總計數 M2 的成長率，但同時承認，在現代經濟中精確衡量貨幣存量相當困難。
華許曾提出，Fed 可以透過縮減資產負債表對經濟形成足夠約束，從而創造調降短期利率的空間。然而，專欄認為，這項主張反而讓政策方向更加混亂。
在現行貨幣政策制度下，信貸與貨幣供給成長主要受到 Fed 短期利率目標影響，貨幣成長與經濟活動之間的關係已比過去更加薄弱。況且，在銀行準備金充裕的制度下，M2 成長通常是信貸需求與經濟成長的結果，而非推動兩者的原因。
只要 Fed 繼續維持充裕準備金制度，單純縮小資產負債表就不太可能對經濟活動產生明顯緊縮效果，也未必足以抵銷降息帶來的寬鬆作用。
專欄警告，除非華許盡快釐清其通膨理論、政策工具與決策邏輯，否則 Fed 的公信力將持續面臨風險。若市場因此不再相信 Fed 有能力或意願控制物價，通膨預期可能逐漸失去錨定，使 Fed 恢復物價穩定的任務變得更加困難。
paras_en: After taking office, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh has had a rocky start. Not only has he refused to explain how monetary policy would be adjusted if the economic outlook changes, his vague statements on the inflation target and policy framework are eroding the Fed’s credibility. Bloomberg’s column notes that abandoning forward guidance might make sense, but if the Fed instead relies on financial markets to gauge policy direction, it creates a deadlock where the central bank and markets wait for each other's signals, ultimately increasing uncertainty, raising risk premiums, and weakening policy credibility.
Warsh’s problem is not merely poor communication; he has consistently failed to clearly explain how he interprets inflation and through what channels monetary policy influences prices.

The credibility of the 2% PCE target may be under threat. In a press conference at the end of July, Warsh hinted that the Fed could stop using the personal consumption expenditures price index (PCE) as the primary inflation gauge as early as after January next year. He said the Fed’s policy strategy after January remains unknown and that a working group might propose a new view.

Warsh invoked the “Lucas critique” and the “Goodhart’s law” to argue that once an inflation indicator is formally set as a policy target, its measurement effectiveness can deteriorate as economic behavior changes. The former means that after policy changes, households and firms adjust their behavior, making previously observed regularities unreliable; the latter points out that an indicator becomes a poor measure once it is turned into a target.

The column argues that hinting at a switch of the main inflation gauge before the Fed has achieved its 2% annual PCE goal is like moving the goalposts before reaching the finish line, making it hard to bolster confidence that the Fed remains committed to price stability.

Warsh also did not clearly identify the main drivers of inflation. For example, after stripping out short‑term supply‑demand shocks, it is still unclear whether core inflation stems from a labor‑supply shortage, the size of the Fed’s balance sheet, money‑supply growth, or financial‑system liquidity.

Warsh appears skeptical of the traditional Phillips‑curve framework, which links an overheated labor market to higher wages and inflation. He emphasized that price stability and high employment need not be inherently at odds. Although he acknowledged the importance of inflation expectations, he did not explain how those expectations form or how Fed policy influences them. A framework that reduces inflation to expectations, expectations to Fed credibility, without incorporating aggregate supply and demand, is unlikely to be convincing.

Warsh seems to place greater emphasis on the Fed’s balance‑sheet size and broad money growth. The latest monetary‑policy report submitted to Congress specifically mentions the growth rate of the broad‑money aggregate M2, while also acknowledging that precisely measuring the money stock in a modern economy is extremely difficult.

Warsh has suggested that the Fed could tighten the economy enough by shrinking its balance sheet, thereby creating room to cut short‑term rates. The column, however, argues that this claim only adds to policy confusion.

Under the current monetary‑policy regime, credit and money‑supply growth are mainly driven by the Fed’s short‑term interest‑rate target, and the link between money growth and economic activity has weakened compared with the past. Moreover, in a system with abundant bank reserves, M2 growth is usually the result of credit demand and economic expansion, not the cause of either.

As long as the Fed maintains an abundant‑reserve framework, merely shrinking the balance sheet is unlikely to produce a noticeable tightening effect on economic activity, nor is it likely to offset the easing impact of rate cuts.

The column warns that unless Warsh quickly clarifies his inflation theory, policy tools, and decision‑making logic, the Fed’s credibility will continue to be at risk. If markets cease to believe the Fed can or will control prices, inflation expectations may gradually lose their anchor, making the Fed’s task of restoring price stability even more difficult.

items.title: 黃仁勳說到做到！輝達不到三周端出開源AI模型
items.title_en: Renesas Delivers on Its Promise: Open-Source AI Model Released in Under Three Weeks
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 推出開源人工智慧模型 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，這是執行長黃仁勳公開加入開源 AI 政策辯論後，公司發表的首款開源模型。輝達表示，新模型採取輕量化設計，可在個人電腦的單張繪圖處理器 (GPU) 上運行，企業能免費下載、使用及修改，無須取得輝達許可或支付費用。
黃仁勳 7 月底首度在社群平台 X 發文，呼籲美國政府支持開放模型，避免過早實施限制，導致 AI 創新與發展移往海外。不到三周後，輝達便正式推出 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，反映這家晶片大廠積極投入開源 AI 生態系的態度。
開源模型雖然免費，對輝達而言仍有助於推升晶片需求。無論模型是否收費，都需要 GPU 執行運算，而較低的使用成本可能促使更多企業採用 AI，進而擴大硬體需求，並與 OpenAI、Anthropic 等公司的專有模型競爭。黃仁勳上月受訪時直言，免費 AI 應該對硬體及晶片產業有利。
黃仁勳加入開源 AI 辯論之際，正值中國月之暗面 (Moonshot AI) 推出 Kimi K3。這款模型縮小與美國最先進 AI 模型之間的差距，引發華府對國家安全及智慧財產權的擔憂。
部分美國政界人士質疑，中國開發商可能透過「蒸餾」技術，利用先進模型服務生成的答案訓練規模較小的模型，並討論是否應仿效晶片出口管制，對中國 AI 業者實施制裁或其他限制。輝達也坦言，Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 同樣運用蒸餾技術，使其在維持較小規模的同時，具備接近大型 Nemotron 模型的能力。
黃仁勳則主張，開放權重模型能讓企業更能掌控自身技術發展，促進競爭並降低使用成本，也有助於強化安全、網路防護、創新擴散及技術自主。輝達隨後並與微軟等公司成立 AI 安全聯盟，聚焦運用開放模型及開源軟體提升網路安全。
開源 AI 也成為矽谷熱門議題。Meta(META-US) 執行長祖克柏本周一發布長篇宣言，主張美國開源模型應成為全球最佳產品，並同步推出程式編寫模型 Muse Spark。
輝達表示，CrowdStrike(CRWD-US)、CodeRabbit 及 Harvey 等公司已測試並客製化 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning。該模型特別針對 AI 代理設計，可讓程式在背景自主執行任務，未來將在 Hugging Face 與輝達官網提供下載。輝達同時推出 NeMo Switchyard 軟體，可依不同工作需求，自動選擇成本最低且最合適的 AI 模型。
paras_en: Renesas (NVDA-US) has released its open-source AI model, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, following the company's CEO, Hidetoshi Shibata, publicly joining the open-source AI policy debate. The new model is designed to be lightweight and can run on a single graphics processing unit (GPU) on a personal computer, allowing enterprises to download, use, and modify it for free without requiring permission or payment from Renesas.

Hidetoshi Shibata first expressed his views on social media platform X at the end of July, urging the US government to support open-source models to avoid premature restrictions that could lead to AI innovation and development shifting overseas. Just under three weeks later, Renesas has officially released Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, reflecting the company's active involvement in the open-source AI ecosystem.

Although the open-source model is free, it still benefits Renesas by boosting chip demand. Regardless of whether the model is paid for, it requires a GPU to run computations, and lower usage costs may encourage more enterprises to adopt AI, expanding hardware demand and competing with proprietary models from companies like OpenAI and Anthropic. Hidetoshi Shibata stated last month that free AI should benefit both hardware and chip industries.

When Hidetoshi Shibata joined the open-source AI debate, China's Moonshot AI was releasing Kimi K3, a model that narrowed the gap with the most advanced US AI models, sparking concerns in Washington about national security and intellectual property rights.

Some US politicians have questioned whether Chinese developers might use 'distillation' technology to train smaller models using answers generated by advanced models, and whether they should follow chip export controls by imposing sanctions or restrictions on Chinese AI companies. Renesas has also acknowledged that Nemotron 3.5 Lightning employs distillation technology, enabling it to maintain a smaller scale while approaching the capabilities of large Nemotron models.

Hidetoshi Shibata argues that open-weight models allow enterprises to better control their technological development, promote competition, reduce usage costs, and enhance security, network protection, innovation diffusion, and technological sovereignty. Renesas has since formed an AI security alliance with Microsoft and other companies to focus on using open models and open-source software to improve network security.

Open-source AI has become a hot topic in Silicon Valley. Meta (META-US) CEO Mark Zuckerberg released a lengthy statement on Monday advocating for the US to become the global leader in open-source models and releasing the programming writing model Muse Spark.

Renesas has stated that CrowdStrike (CRWD-US), CodeRabbit, and Harvey have tested and customized Nemotron 3.5 Lightning. The model is particularly designed for AI agent design, allowing programs to autonomously execute tasks in the background. In the future, it will be available for download on Hugging Face and Renesas' official website. Renesas has also released NeMo Switchyard software, which automatically selects the most cost-effective and suitable AI model based on different work requirements.

items.title: 財報季亮眼爆發！富國銀行：標普500獲利上修潮史上最強 點名三大類股浮現買點
items.title_en: Earnings Season Shines! Wells Fargo: S&P 500 Profit Revisions the Strongest Ever, Highlights Three Sectors with Buying Opportunities
paras: 富國銀行證券 (Wells Fargo Securities) 表示，標普 500 指數的獲利表現正變得更強勁且更廣泛，這對股市而言是好消息，尤其有利於工業、金融與科技類股。
目前標普 500 指數已有 80% 成分股公布財報，幾乎可以確定第 2 季財報季有望交出亮眼成績。整體而言，標普 500 企業 EPS 平均超越華爾街預期 8%，且預估獲利將較去年同期增加約 30%。根據富國銀行，這將是 2021 年第 4 季以來最快的獲利增速。
值得注意的是，到目前為止，非科技企業的獲利表現優於科技業，超越市場預期的幅度更大。非科技企業的獲利約超越預期 10%，而「科技七巨頭」(Magnificent Seven) 加上科技業者則超越市場預期 4%。
強勁的財報表現已促使華爾街上修 2026 年下半年及更長期的獲利展望。自 7 月 1 日以來，標普 500 指數 2026 年下半年獲利預估已調升 0.8%，而分析師在財報季進入當前階段時通常會將預估調降 1.2%。
富國銀行首席股票策略師 Ohsung Kwon 率領的團隊表示，2027 年獲利預估迄今已上修 1.6%。
Kwon 的團隊表示：「2027 年 EPS 正出現史上最強勁的上修趨勢。企業財測也相當強勁，有 54% 的 EPS 財測高於市場共識，接近歷史高點。」
Kwon 指出，股市表現與獲利預期之間日益擴大的落差，可能為投資人帶來機會。儘管獲利動能強勁，科技、工業及金融類股的股價報酬仍未跟上獲利預估上修的腳步。
富國銀行團隊說：「我們加碼布局的科技、工業及金融類股，本季基本面與股價表現出現分歧，我們認為這提供具吸引力的買進機會。」
除了獲利成長之外，非科技企業的資本支出也開始回升。
近期美國資本支出主要由人工智慧 (AI) 相關投資主導，但富國銀行表示，這種情況正開始改變。這可能促使參與這些投資計畫的企業增加活動，包括負責建設及提供融資的公司，最終也將帶動更廣泛的經濟活動。
富國銀行策略師說：「數據顯示，擁有大型資料中心運營的地區，當地經濟已出現顯著效益。自 2024 年以來，這些地區新建住宅數量增加 50%，房價上漲 14%，就業人口增加 3.7%。」
paras_en: Wells Fargo Securities says the profit performance of the S&P 500 is becoming stronger and broader, which is good news for the market and especially benefits industrial, financial and technology stocks.

About 80% of the S&P 500 constituents have reported earnings, making it almost certain that the Q2 earnings season will deliver impressive results. Overall, S&P 500 companies’ EPS is on average 8% above Wall Street expectations, and earnings are projected to be roughly 30% higher than a year ago. According to Wells Fargo, this would be the fastest earnings growth since Q4 2021.

Notably, to date non‑technology firms are beating expectations by a larger margin than tech firms. Non‑tech earnings are about 10% above forecasts, while the “Magnificent Seven” plus other tech companies are only about 4% ahead of expectations.

The strong earnings have already prompted Wall Street to lift its profit outlook for the second half of 2026 and beyond. Since July 1, the 2026 H2 earnings estimate for the S&P 500 has been raised by 0.8%, whereas analysts typically cut estimates by 1.2% as the earnings season progresses into its current phase.
Wells Fargo’s chief equity strategist Ohsung Kwon and his team say the 2027 earnings estimate has already been revised up by 1.6% so far.
Kwon’s team adds: “The 2027 EPS revision trend is the strongest ever. Corporate earnings forecasts are also robust, with 54% of EPS forecasts above market consensus, near historic highs.”

Kwon points out that the widening gap between market performance and earnings expectations could create opportunities for investors. Despite strong earnings momentum, the price returns of tech, industrial and financial stocks have not kept pace with the upward earnings revisions.

The Wells Fargo team says: “We are increasing our positions in tech, industrial and financial stocks. This quarter the fundamentals and price performance have diverged, which we view as an attractive buying opportunity.”
In addition to earnings growth, capital spending by non‑technology firms is also beginning to rebound.

Recent U.S. capital spending has been dominated by AI‑related investments, but Wells Fargo says that trend is starting to shift. This could spur increased activity by companies involved in these projects, including builders and financiers, ultimately driving broader economic activity.

Wells Fargo strategists note: “Data show that regions hosting large data‑center operations have seen significant local economic benefits. Since 2024, new housing starts in those areas have risen 50%, home prices are up 14%, and employment has grown 3.7%.”

items.title: AI狂潮強彈！上櫃公司7月營收3576億暴增43% 金融、營造及光電「倒退嚕」
items.title_en: Taiwan's Upgraded Companies See 43% Revenue Growth in July, Led by AI and Electronics
paras: 上櫃公司 115 年 7 月營收繳出亮眼成績單，單月營收總計 3576 億元，較 114 年同期大幅成長 43%，展現強勁成長動能。在 AI 應用與電子需求暢旺帶動下，半導體與電腦週邊產業成為營收暴增的核心推手，7 月營收呈現衰退的產業為金融業、建材營造及光電業。
櫃買中心指出，截至 115 年 8 月 10 日，全體 890 家上櫃公司（含 30 家 KY 公司）已全部完成 115 年 7 月營收申報。統計顯示，全體上櫃公司 7 月單月營收達 3576 億元，較 114 年同期增加 1076 億元，年增率高達 43%。其中營收成長公司高達 648 家，衰退公司僅 239 家，持平者 3 家，成長公司占比逾 7 成，顯示整體市場基本面持續熱絡。
進一步觀察前 7 月表現，全體上櫃公司累計營收已達 2 兆 2101 億元，較 114 年同期成長 4806 億元，累計年增率達 28%。其中累計營收成長公司共 619 家，衰退 270 家，持平 1 家，同樣維持穩健向上趨勢。
從產業別來看，7 月營收表現最為驚人的三大主要成長產業為半導體業、電腦及週邊設備業與電子通路業。
櫃買中心分析，主要受惠於 AI 應用及企業級儲存需求強勁，加上記憶體需求旺盛、價格調漲，推升電子三大供應鏈單月營收顯著成長。其中，半導體業 7 月營收達 1029 億元，年增 102%，呈現翻倍爆發；電子通路業營收 189 億元，年增 166%；電腦及週邊設備業營收 383 億元，年增 73%。
累計至 7 月的表現方面，半導體業、電腦及週邊設備業與其他電子業亦包辦成長前三名。其中其他電子業主要受惠於 AI 伺服器散熱需求暢旺、半導體擴廠效應及貴金屬價格上揚，帶動前 7 月累計營收大幅走揚。
相較之下，部分產業表現則相對沉悶。7 月衰退主要產業為金融業、建材營造及光電業。金融業主因金融市場波動認列評價損失影響；建材營造業因依建案完工交屋進度認列收入致營收下滑 15%；光電業則受終端需求疲弱及 IC 缺貨衝擊，營收年減 2%。前 7 月累計營收衰退產業則以建材營造、運動休閒及紡織纖維為主，後兩者主要受到客戶拉貨排程調整與部分公司營運轉型期影響。
paras_en: Taiwan's upgraded companies saw a remarkable revenue growth in July, with a total of NT$3576 billion, a 43% increase from the same period last year. This strong growth is driven by the booming demand for AI applications and electronics, with the semiconductor and computer peripheral industries being the core drivers of revenue growth. In contrast, the financial, construction, and electronics industries showed a decline in revenue.

According to the Taiwan Stock Exchange, as of August 10, all 890 upgraded companies (including 30 Kuo Yuan companies) have completed their July revenue reports. The statistics show that the total revenue of all upgraded companies in July reached NT$3576 billion, an increase of NT$1076 billion from the same period last year, with a year-on-year growth rate of 43%. Among them, 648 companies saw revenue growth, while 239 companies saw a decline, and 3 companies remained unchanged. The growth companies accounted for over 7% of the total, indicating that the overall market fundamentals remain hot.

Looking at the first seven months of the year, the total revenue of all upgraded companies reached NT$2.2101 trillion, an increase of NT$4806 billion from the same period last year, with a year-on-year growth rate of 28%. Among them, 619 companies saw revenue growth, while 270 companies saw a decline, and 1 company remained unchanged, maintaining a stable upward trend.
From an industry perspective, the three main growth industries in July were the semiconductor industry, computer and peripheral equipment industry, and electronic channel industry.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange analysis found that the main beneficiaries of the growth were AI applications and enterprise-level storage demand, as well as strong memory demand and price increases, which boosted the electronic three major supply chain single-month revenue growth. Among them, the semiconductor industry saw revenue of NT$102.9 billion, a year-on-year growth of 102%, showing a doubling explosion; the electronic channel industry saw revenue of NT$18.9 billion, a year-on-year growth of 166%; and the computer and peripheral equipment industry saw revenue of NT$38.3 billion, a year-on-year growth of 73%.

In terms of cumulative performance up to July, the semiconductor industry, computer and peripheral equipment industry, and other electronic industries also took the top three spots. Among them, other electronic industries were mainly driven by AI server heat dissipation demand, semiconductor expansion effects, and precious metal price increases, leading to a significant surge in cumulative revenue.

In contrast, some industries performed relatively poorly. The main declining industries in July were the financial industry, construction and building materials industry, and electronics industry. The financial industry was affected by market fluctuations and valuation losses; the construction and building materials industry was affected by the recognition of income based on the completion of construction projects and the decline in revenue by 15%; and the electronics industry was affected by weak terminal demand and IC shortages, with revenue decreasing by 2% year-on-year. The cumulative revenue of declining industries up to July was mainly driven by the construction and building materials industry, sports and leisure industry, and textile fibers industry, with the latter two mainly affected by customer inventory adjustments and some companies' operational transformation periods.

items.title: 輝達5000億美元AI融資推升風險 木頭姐卻加碼12萬股
items.title_en: NVIDIA's $50 Billion AI Financing Boosts Risk, Wood's Ark Invest Adds 122,422 Shares
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 股價周二盤反彈，這家晶片大廠計劃為客戶籌措高達 5,000 億美元融資，目前初步獲得股東正面回應，包括「木頭姐」伍德旗下方舟投資（ARK Invest）也趁勢加碼買進。
輝達周一 (10 日) 股價下跌 2.9%。當天公司宣布與多家華爾街金融機構簽署合作備忘錄，計劃提供總額達 5,000 億美元的資金，供人工智慧（AI）企業投資採購輝達硬體設備。
這項布局背後的邏輯相當明確。輝達一直透過投資整個 AI 生態系（特別是依賴其晶片的較小型企業）來緩解融資瓶頸。然而，輝達的資產負債表有其極限，因此必須引進外部投資人，為客戶解鎖更龐大的資金活水。
Wedbush 分析師 Matt Bryson 在研究報告中指出：「對於非超大規模雲端業者（hyperscaler）及前沿模型業者所建置的資料中心而言，輝達目前仍幾乎是唯一的基礎設施供應商。我們認為，這項基金將成為另一項機制，有望支持輝達在超大規模雲端業者以外市場的領導地位與成長。」
表面上來看，這項安排也能將此類交易排除在自身資產負債表之外，進而降低輝達的風險。不過，投資人或許應密切關注輝達執行長黃仁勳的說法，他透露該公司可能會為特定投資提供擔保機制。
黃仁勳在社群平台 X 上發文表示：「在某些情況下，輝達可能會針對個別專案進行審慎評估，為高達 25% 的投資機會提供剩餘價值支持機制。此類支持額度有限、以剩餘價值為基礎，旨在輔助而非取代獨立的授信審查。」
儘管目前尚不清楚這類「支持機制」具體將如何運作，但這番說法顯示，黃仁勳並不排斥進一步動用輝達的資產負債表。此前也有報導指出，輝達正洽談為 OpenAI 位於俄亥俄州的大型資料中心租賃及債務提供最高 2,500 億美元擔保。
另一方面，部分投資人可能樂見輝達積極鞏固其在 AI 競賽中的關鍵地位。方舟投資執行長暨投資長伍德似乎正持這種看法，她周一透過旗下多檔 ETF，合計買進 122,422 股輝達股票。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) stock price rebounded on Tuesday after the chipmaker announced plans to raise up to $50 billion in financing for its customers, with initial positive feedback from shareholders, including Wood's Ark Invest, which added to its stake.

NVIDIA's stock price fell 2.9% on Monday (10th). The company announced a cooperation agreement with several Wall Street financial institutions, planning to provide a total of $50 billion in funds for AI companies to invest in NVIDIA hardware.

The logic behind this move is clear. NVIDIA has been investing in the entire AI ecosystem (especially smaller companies that rely on its chips) to alleviate funding bottlenecks. However, NVIDIA's balance sheet has its limits, so it must introduce external investors to unlock a larger pool of funds for its customers.

Wedbush analyst Matt Bryson pointed out in a research report: 'For non-hyperscale cloud providers and leading-edge model builders, NVIDIA is currently the only infrastructure supplier. We believe this fund will become another mechanism to support NVIDIA's leadership and growth in the market beyond hyperscale cloud providers.'

On the surface, this arrangement may also remove such transactions from NVIDIA's balance sheet, thereby reducing its risk. However, investors may want to closely monitor CEO Jensen Huang's statement that the company may provide a guarantee mechanism for certain investments.

Huang stated on social media platform X: 'In some cases, NVIDIA may conduct a prudent evaluation for individual projects and provide a residual value support mechanism for up to 25% of investment opportunities. This support is limited, based on residual value, and aims to assist rather than replace independent credit review.'

Although the specifics of this 'support mechanism' are unclear, Huang's statement suggests that he is not ruling out further use of NVIDIA's balance sheet. There have also been reports that NVIDIA is in talks to provide up to $25 billion in guarantees for OpenAI's large data center in Ohio.

On the other hand, some investors may welcome NVIDIA's efforts to solidify its key position in the AI competition. Ark Invest CEO and CIO Cathie Wood appears to hold this view, as she bought 122,422 NVIDIA shares through her various ETFs on Monday.

items.title: 光群雷決議明起進場股價25元以下買5000張庫藏股護盤
items.title_en: Guanqun Lei Approves Buying 5,000 Shares of Treasury Stock at 25 TWD or Below Starting from December 12
paras: 光群雷 (2461-TW) 今 (11) 日決議自明 (12) 日起進場，在兩個月內於每股 25 元以下買 5000 張庫藏股護盤，光群雷指出，買回 5000 張庫藏股用途在維護公司信用及股東權益。
光群雷決議在每股 12.25 元至 25 元區間內買回 5000 張庫藏股，股價低於 12.25 元下限時仍將繼續買進。光群雷預定買回 5000 張庫藏股將占股本比重 2.61%。
光群雷今天晚間並公布上半年財報，營收 26.7 億元，稅後純益 1.13 億元，較去年同期由虧轉盈，每股純益爲 0.64 元。
光群雷股價今天收在每股 17.25 元。
paras_en: Guanqun Lei (2461-TW) has approved a plan to enter the market starting from December 12, and purchase up to 5,000 shares of treasury stock at 25 TWD or below within two months. Guanqun Lei stated that the 5,000 shares of treasury stock will be used to maintain the company's credit and shareholders' rights.

Guanqun Lei has approved a plan to purchase 5,000 shares of treasury stock within the price range of 12.25 TWD to 25 TWD per share. If the stock price falls below the 12.25 TWD lower limit, Guanqun Lei will continue to purchase the treasury stock. The 5,000 shares of treasury stock to be purchased will account for 2.61% of the company's outstanding shares.

Guanqun Lei announced its first-half financial report in the evening, with revenue of 2.67 billion TWD, net profit of 113 million TWD, and a net profit per share of 0.64 TWD. The company turned from a loss to a profit compared to the same period last year.
Guanqun Lei's stock price closed at 17.25 TWD per share today.

累計至 7 月的表現方面，半導體業、電腦及週邊設備業與其他電子業亦包辦成長前三名。其中其他電子業主要受惠於 AI 伺服器散熱需求暢旺、半導體擴廠效應及貴金屬價格上揚，帶動前 7 月累計營收大幅走揚。
相較之下，部分產業表現則相對沉悶。7 月衰退主要產業為金融業、建材營造及光電業。金融業主因金融市場波動認列評價損失影響；建材營造業因依建案完工交屋進度認列收入致營收下滑 15%；光電業則受終端需求疲弱及 IC 缺貨衝擊，營收年減 2%。前 7 月累計營收衰退產業則以建材營造、運動休閒及紡織纖維為主，後兩者主要受到客戶拉貨排程調整與部分公司營運轉型期影響。
paras_en: Taiwan's upgraded companies saw a remarkable revenue growth in July, with a total of NT$3576 billion, a 43% increase from the same period last year. This strong growth is driven by the booming demand for AI applications and electronics, with the semiconductor and computer peripheral industries being the core drivers of revenue growth. In contrast, the financial, construction, and electronics industries showed a decline in revenue.

According to the Taiwan Stock Exchange, as of August 10, all 890 upgraded companies (including 30 Kuo Yuan companies) have completed their July revenue reports. The statistics show that the total revenue of all upgraded companies in July reached NT$3576 billion, an increase of NT$1076 billion from the same period last year, with a year-on-year growth rate of 43%. Among them, 648 companies saw revenue growth, while 239 companies saw a decline, and 3 companies remained unchanged. The growth companies accounted for over 7% of the total, indicating that the overall market fundamentals remain hot.

Looking at the first seven months of the year, the total revenue of all upgraded companies reached NT$2.2101 trillion, an increase of NT$4806 billion from the same period last year, with a year-on-year growth rate of 28%. Among them, 619 companies saw revenue growth, while 270 companies saw a decline, and 1 company remained unchanged, maintaining a stable upward trend.
From an industry perspective, the three main growth industries in July were the semiconductor industry, computer and peripheral equipment industry, and electronic channel industry.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange analysis found that the main beneficiaries of the growth were AI applications and enterprise-level storage demand, as well as strong memory demand and price increases, which boosted the electronic three major supply chain single-month revenue growth. Among them, the semiconductor industry saw revenue of NT$102.9 billion, a year-on-year growth of 102%, showing a doubling explosion; the electronic channel industry saw revenue of NT$18.9 billion, a year-on-year growth of 166%; and the computer and peripheral equipment industry saw revenue of NT$38.3 billion, a year-on-year growth of 73%.

In terms of cumulative performance up to July, the semiconductor industry, computer and peripheral equipment industry, and other electronic industries also took the top three spots. Among them, other electronic industries were mainly driven by AI server heat dissipation demand, semiconductor expansion effects, and precious metal price increases, leading to a significant surge in cumulative revenue.

In contrast, some industries performed relatively poorly. The main declining industries in July were the financial industry, construction and building materials industry, and electronics industry. The financial industry was affected by market fluctuations and valuation losses; the construction and building materials industry was affected by the recognition of income based on the completion of construction projects and the decline in revenue by 15%; and the electronics industry was affected by weak terminal demand and IC shortages, with revenue decreasing by 2% year-on-year. The cumulative revenue of declining industries up to July was mainly driven by the construction and building materials industry, sports and leisure industry, and textile fibers industry, with the latter two mainly affected by customer inventory adjustments and some companies' operational transformation periods.

items.title: 光群雷決議明起進場股價25元以下買5000張庫藏股護盤
items.title_en: Guanqun Lei Approves Buying 5,000 Shares of Treasury Stock at 25 TWD or Below Starting from December 12
paras: 光群雷 (2461-TW) 今 (11) 日決議自明 (12) 日起進場，在兩個月內於每股 25 元以下買 5000 張庫藏股護盤，光群雷指出，買回 5000 張庫藏股用途在維護公司信用及股東權益。
光群雷決議在每股 12.25 元至 25 元區間內買回 5000 張庫藏股，股價低於 12.25 元下限時仍將繼續買進。光群雷預定買回 5000 張庫藏股將占股本比重 2.61%。
光群雷今天晚間並公布上半年財報，營收 26.7 億元，稅後純益 1.13 億元，較去年同期由虧轉盈，每股純益爲 0.64 元。
光群雷股價今天收在每股 17.25 元。
paras_en: Guanqun Lei (2461-TW) has approved a plan to enter the market starting from December 12, and purchase up to 5,000 shares of treasury stock at 25 TWD or below within two months. Guanqun Lei stated that the 5,000 shares of treasury stock will be used to maintain the company's credit and shareholders' rights.

Guanqun Lei has approved a plan to purchase 5,000 shares of treasury stock within the price range of 12.25 TWD to 25 TWD per share. If the stock price falls below the 12.25 TWD lower limit, Guanqun Lei will continue to purchase the treasury stock. The 5,000 shares of treasury stock to be purchased will account for 2.61% of the company's outstanding shares.

Guanqun Lei announced its first-half financial report in the evening, with revenue of 2.67 billion TWD, net profit of 113 million TWD, and a net profit per share of 0.64 TWD. The company turned from a loss to a profit compared to the same period last year.
Guanqun Lei's stock price closed at 17.25 TWD per share today.

items.title: 淘寶「陸機」化整為零？跨部會突襲新北稽查 違法輸入中國重機下場曝光
items.title_en: Taobao 'Lujiji' dismantled? Cross-agency raid in New Taipei City exposes illegal import of Chinese heavy machinery
paras: 經濟部針對近期有業者透過社群媒體展示將中國大陸重型機車零組件分拆後分批輸入台灣，再於國內組裝成車、疑有規避我國輸入管理規定的情形，今（11) 日表示，已邀集財政部關務署、交通部及內政部警政署召開會議並成立聯合查緝小組，分別於 8 月 7 日及今日前往新北市涉案營業場所執行查緝。今日查緝發現之重型機車，依據業者提供進口報單資訊，海關遂依海關緝私條例相關規定當場扣押涉案車輛辦理後續程序。
經濟部表示，依據台灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例第 35 條規定，中國大陸重型機車整車及引擎屬於不准輸入項目，未經許可不得輸入我國。本案涉案業者疑似以拆解機車零組件後分批輸入，再於國內組裝成車的方式，規避現行輸入管理規定。
經濟部說明，海關於完成相關調查後，將把違規事證移送經濟部議處。經濟部將依台灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例第 86 條第 5 項規定，視違規情節輕重，對違規行為人處以停止 2 個月以上、1 年以下輸入貨品，或廢止其出進口廠商登記之行政處分，以維護我國貿易秩序。
此外，若涉案車輛未經檢測審驗合格或未依法領用牌照即行駛道路，則涉有違反道路交通管理處罰條例第 12 條規定。依規定，未領用牌照行駛道路者，得處車輛所有人罰鍰並沒入車輛；如有懸掛偽造、變造號牌或使用他車號牌等情形，均得依法沒入車輛。
經濟部另指出，如業者係以常態化方式於國內組裝中國大陸製重型機車，依大陸地區產業技術引進許可辦法規定，應事先申請許可，且須以不妨害國家安全及經濟發展為限。考量我國重型機車產業發展成熟，相關產品供應充足，如引進中國大陸重型機車生產技術或組裝模式，恐對國內產業及市場秩序造成衝擊，因此經濟部不會核發相關許可。
經濟部強調，政府對於大陸地區物品輸入管理及邊境查緝採取嚴格把關立場，任何企圖透過拆解、分批運輸、組裝成車等方式規避法令管制之行為，均將依法查辦。未來將持續結合財政部關務署、交通部及內政部警政署等機關力量，強化跨部會情資共享、聯合查緝及市場稽查作為，積極防堵違規輸入案件。
經濟部並呼籲業者應確實遵守相關輸入管理及交通安全法規，切勿心存僥倖以身試法；民眾選購車輛時亦應留意產品來源、合法進口證明及領牌情形，共同維護公平交易秩序、產業發展及道路交通安全。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs has taken action against recent cases of Taiwanese companies importing Chinese heavy machinery components, disassembling them, and reassembling them in Taiwan to avoid import regulations. On August 11, the ministry announced that it had convened a meeting with the Ministry of Finance's Customs Administration, the Ministry of Transportation and Communications, and the National Police Agency to form a joint investigation team. The team conducted raids on suspected companies in New Taipei City on August 7 and today.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated that, according to Article 35 of the Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area, Chinese heavy machinery and engines are prohibited from being imported into Taiwan without a permit. The suspected companies allegedly disassembled the machinery components, imported them in batches, and reassembled them in Taiwan to avoid the current import regulations.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs explained that, after completing the investigation, the Customs Administration will hand over the evidence to the Ministry of Economic Affairs for further action. The ministry will impose administrative penalties on the violators, including stopping the import of goods for two months to one year or revoking their import and export business registration, in accordance with Article 86, Section 5 of the Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area.

Additionally, if the vehicles are driven on the road without undergoing inspection and testing or without obtaining a license, they may be in violation of Article 12 of the Road Traffic Management and Punishment Act. According to the regulations, the vehicle owner may be fined and the vehicle seized. If the vehicle has a fake or altered license plate or is using a license plate from another vehicle, it may also be seized.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs also pointed out that, if Taiwanese companies regularly assemble Chinese heavy machinery in Taiwan, they must first obtain a permit under the Regulations Governing the Importation of Industrial Technology from the Mainland Area. The permit is subject to the condition that it does not harm national security or economic development. Considering Taiwan's mature heavy machinery industry, the ministry will not issue permits for the importation of Chinese heavy machinery production technology or assembly methods, as it may disrupt the domestic industry and market order.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs emphasized that the government takes a strict approach to managing the importation of goods from the Mainland Area and conducting border inspections. Any attempt to evade regulations by disassembling, shipping in batches, or reassembling vehicles will be investigated and prosecuted in accordance with the law. In the future, the ministry will continue to collaborate with the Ministry of Finance's Customs Administration, the Ministry of Transportation and Communications, and the National Police Agency to strengthen cross-agency information sharing, joint investigations, and market inspections to prevent illegal importation cases.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs also urged businesses to comply with relevant import regulations and traffic safety laws, and not to take risks by violating the law. Consumers should also be aware of the origin of the products, import certificates, and license plates when purchasing vehicles to maintain fair trade, industry development, and road safety.

items.title: 景美上半年EPS 2.56元 超越2025年全年
items.title_en: Jingmei Surpasses 2025 Full-Year EPS with 2.56 NT$
paras: 測試介面結構件廠景美科技 (7899-TW) 今 (11) 日公告上半年財報，受惠客戶需求放大，經濟規模效益顯現，上半年稅後淨利 0.59 億元，年增 163%，每股稅後盈餘 2.56 元，已超越去年全年。
景美科技上半年營收 3.9 億元，年增 78.71%，營業利益 0.81 億元，年增 97.48%，營益率 20.8%，年增 2 個百分點，稅後淨利 0.59 億元，年增 163%，稅後淨利率 15%，年增 4.8 個百分點，每股稅後盈餘 2.56 元。
景美科技指出，上半年營業費用率由去年同期的 24% 下降至 19%，反映營收規模放大後的費用攤提效率提升，是營益率與稅後淨利率同步走高的主因；上半年毛利率 39.7%，亦高於 2025 年全年的 38.4%。整體而言，獲利成長幅度明顯大於營收成長幅度。
以獲利水準觀察，上半年每股稅後盈餘 2.56 元，已高於 2025 年全年的 1.53 元與 2024 年全年的 1.80 元；稅後淨利亦達 2025 年全年的 1.78 倍，僅六個月即改寫公司歷年全年最佳獲利紀錄。
景美科技 7 月營收 0.72 億元，年增 112%，為單月次高，連續七個月改寫同期紀錄，累計前 7 月營收 4.62 億元，年增 83.2%，已超越 2025 年全年營收。
總經理羅麗文表示，探針卡結構件屬高度客製化產品，單月出貨節奏受客戶專案排程與交期安排影響，月度之間出現波動屬正常現象，採季度趨勢觀察營運體質更為客觀；就累計數字而言，全年成長動能未見改變。成長動能主要反映 AI、高效能運算 (HPC) 與先進製程測試需求持續放大，帶動探針卡關鍵結構件、細微鑽孔件與測試機框 (Stiffener) 出貨同步成長。
景美科技上半年產品組合，探針卡結構組件占 48%、探針卡細微鑽孔占 26%、探針卡機框 (ATE Stiffener) 占 11%，三大探針卡相關產品線合計占營收 85%。
其中探針卡結構組件仍為公司最大宗產品線；探針卡機框比重較 2025 年的 9% 明顯提升，主要係公司於去年第四季順利通過晶圓代工廠驗證、正式切入日系測試機框供應，並自今年第一季起穩定出貨所致。
發言人鄭雅文表示，今年成長並非依賴單一產品線拉抬。隨 AI 與 HPC 晶片訊號接點密度提高、單卡針數與孔位密度同步上升，導板細微鑽孔、精密結構件加工與整合組裝三大能力均出現需求成長；由於細微鑽孔多以孔數計價，針數越高、孔位越密集，對應加工價值亦隨之提高，形成具延續性的結構性成長動能。
展望後市，在 AI、先進封裝與高階測試需求長期成長趨勢明確下，景美科技將持續以技術領先、品質穩定與量產交付三大核心優勢，朝向全球先進製程測試介面關鍵結構件供應商目標穩健邁進。
paras_en: Jingmei Technology (7899-TW) announced its first-half financial report today, benefiting from increased customer demand and economies of scale, with a net profit of NT$5.9 billion, a 163% year-over-year increase, and an EPS of NT$2.56, surpassing last year's full-year EPS.

Jingmei Technology's first-half revenue was NT$3.9 billion, a 78.71% year-over-year increase, with an operating profit of NT$810 million, a 97.48% year-over-year increase, and an operating margin of 20.8%, a 2 percentage point increase, with a net profit of NT$590 million, a 163% year-over-year increase, and a net profit margin of 15%, a 4.8 percentage point increase, and an EPS of NT$2.56.

Jingmei Technology pointed out that its operating expense ratio decreased from 24% in the same period last year to 19%, reflecting the efficiency improvement in cost allocation after revenue scale expansion, which is the main reason for the simultaneous increase in operating margin and net profit margin.

From a profitability perspective, the EPS of NT$2.56 in the first half of the year has surpassed NT$1.53 in 2025 and NT$1.80 in 2024, and the net profit has reached 1.78 times that of 2025, rewriting the company's best-ever full-year profit record in just six months.

Jingmei Technology's revenue in July was NT$720 million, a 112% year-over-year increase, the highest single-month revenue, and has rewritten the same-period record for seven consecutive months, with a cumulative revenue of NT$4.62 billion in the first seven months, a 83.2% year-over-year increase, surpassing the full-year revenue of 2025.

CEO Lo Li-wen stated that probe cards are highly customized products, and monthly shipments are affected by customer project schedules and delivery arrangements, resulting in fluctuations between months, which is a normal phenomenon, and observing quarterly trends is more objective in assessing operating conditions.

The growth momentum is mainly reflected in the continuous expansion of AI, HPC, and advanced process testing demands, driving the growth of probe card key structural components, fine-drilled components, and test machine frames (Stiffener) shipments simultaneously.

Jingmei Technology's first-half product mix, probe card structural components accounted for 48%, probe card fine-drilled components accounted for 26%, and probe card machine frames (ATE Stiffener) accounted for 11%, with the three major probe card-related product lines accounting for 85% of revenue.

Among them, probe card structural components are still the company's largest product line, and probe card machine frames have increased significantly from 9% in 2025, mainly due to the company's successful verification of wafer manufacturing factories last year and formal entry into the supply of Japanese test machine frames, and stable shipments since the first quarter of this year.

Spokesperson Zheng Ya-ven stated that this year's growth is not dependent on a single product line, and as AI and HPC chip signal contact density increases, single-card pin numbers and hole density also rise, leading to increased demand for board fine-drilled components, precision structural components, and integrated assembly capabilities, and since fine-drilled components are often priced by hole count, higher pin numbers and higher hole density result in higher processing values, forming a sustainable structural growth momentum.

items.title: 萬泰科Q2獲利翻倍 總經理張程雅轉任執行長、謝明遠接新總座
items.title_en: Wan Tai Science and Technology Q2 Profit Doubles, CEO Zhang Chengya Transfers to President, and Xie Mingyuan Takes Over as New CEO
paras: 連接線廠萬泰科 (6190-TW) 今 (11) 日公告第二季財報，稅後純益 1.69 億元，季增 113%、年增 160%；每股純益 0.92 元；上半年稅後純益 2.49 億元，年增 37.13%、每股純益 1.35 元。萬泰科也公告，總經理張程雅轉任執行長、線纜事業群營運長謝明遠新任總經理。
萬泰科說明，考量東南亞地區為集團未來新產品研發及產能擴充的發展重點，故由現任總經理張程雅轉任執行長，為東南亞地區提供策略指導；而新任總經理謝明遠相關學經歷豐富，對公司營運與產業趨勢有深刻理解，期能帶領集團持續成長。
萬泰科第二季營收 29.79 億元，季增 19.57%、年增 32.84%、毛利率 15.27%，季增 0.06 個百分點、年減 3.56 個百分點、營業利益 2.17 億元，季增 58.69%、年增 15.41%、營業利益率 7.30%，季增 1.80 個百分點、年減 1.10 個百分點。
萬泰科上半年營收 54.71 億元，年增 21.44%、毛利率 15.25%，年減 2.39 個百分點、營業利益 3.54 億元，年增 7.71%、營業利益率 6.48%，年減 0.83 個百分點。公司看好，受惠 AI 高速線、衛星線與輻照交聯線等高毛利產品持續成長，營運逐季向上，下半年可望優於上半年。
paras_en: Wan Tai Science and Technology (6190-TW) announced its second-quarter earnings today, with a net profit of NT$1.69 billion, up 113% from the previous quarter and 160% from the same period last year. The company's earnings per share were NT$0.92. For the first half of the year, the company's net profit was NT$2.49 billion, up 37.13% from the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$1.35.

Wan Tai Science and Technology stated that, considering Southeast Asia as a key area for the group's future product development and capacity expansion, the current CEO Zhang Chengya will transfer to the position of president to provide strategic guidance for the region. The new CEO Xie Mingyuan has rich experience and a deep understanding of the company's operations and industry trends, and is expected to lead the company to continued growth.

Wan Tai Science and Technology's second-quarter revenue was NT$29.79 billion, up 19.57% from the previous quarter and 32.84% from the same period last year. The company's gross margin was 15.27%, up 0.06 percentage points from the previous quarter and down 3.56 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's operating income was NT$2.17 billion, up 58.69% from the previous quarter and 15.41% from the same period last year, with an operating margin of 7.30%, up 1.80 percentage points from the previous quarter and down 1.10 percentage points from the same period last year.

Wan Tai Science and Technology's first-half revenue was NT$54.71 billion, up 21.44% from the same period last year, with a gross margin of 15.25%, down 2.39 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's operating income was NT$3.54 billion, up 7.71% from the same period last year, with an operating margin of 6.48%, down 0.83 percentage points from the same period last year. The company is optimistic about its prospects, with high-margin products such as AI high-speed lines, satellite lines, and radiation-interconnected lines expected to continue growing, and operations expected to improve quarter by quarter, with the second half of the year expected to be better than the first half.

items.title: 刷卡繳稅助攻！6月簽帳金額7887億元寫新高 上半年非現金支付衝破5兆元
items.title_en: Credit Card Payments Boost Tax Payments! June's Signed Amount Reaches NT$788.7 Billion, a New High
paras: 金管會今 (11) 日公布 2026 年 6 月信用卡、現金卡及電子支付業務統計，受惠於綜合所得稅刷卡稅款於 6 月入帳，加上國旅消費暢旺，單月信用卡簽帳金額高達 7,887 億元，年增逾 1 倍，刷新歷史單月新高紀錄；上半年累計簽帳金額達 2 兆 8,769 億元，亦創下歷年同期新高，年增 27.87%。上半年非現金支付半年衝破 5 兆元，銀行局對於全年達標 10 兆目標樂觀看待。
銀行局副局長王允中指出，今年繳稅金額約 2700 億元在 6 月請款入帳，相較於去年大部分稅款於 7 月入帳，時間差使得今年 6 月簽帳金額暴增，年增率高達 100.33%。
當月簽帳金額前五大發卡銀行依序為玉山銀行、中國信託、國泰世華、台新銀行與台北富邦銀行。玉山銀行單月刷卡量飆出 1,609 億元，年增幅達驚人的 224%，創下該行單月歷史新高。
在發卡與停卡表現方面，國泰世華因台塑聯名卡合約到期，積極換發 Cube 卡，帶動單月發卡量登頂，達 22.8 萬卡；星展銀行則因清查並停用 12 個月以上未消費的呆卡，致使單月停卡數明顯增加。
截至今年 6 月底止，32 家發卡機構信用卡整體流通卡數約 5,981 萬張，有效卡數約 4,011 萬張。當月簽帳金額約 7,887 億元，較上月大增約 3,685 億元
電子支付方面，總使用者人數達 4,113 萬人，單月增加約 36 萬人。不過，受到母親節檔期結束及稅款繳納結束影響，單月代理收付實質交易金額降至 296.5 億元，月減 22.2 億元。
金管會訂定 2026 年非現金支付目標為「交易筆數達 80 億筆、金額達 10 兆元」。今年 年上半年非現金支付成績單亮眼，交易筆數達 46.04 億筆，年增 10.07%，目標達成率為 57.55%。交易金額為 5.15 兆元，年增 26.42%，目標達成率 51.54%。
王允中分析筆數達成率顯著高於金額的原因，主要歸因於小額消費普及。依據統計資料，儲值卡雖然在交易金額僅占整體非現金支付的 0.73%，但在交易筆數的占比卻高達 38.91%；相對地，信用卡則占總交易金額的 55.82%，占交易筆數 40.87%。
王允中表示，隨著民眾對電子支付與信用卡的使用習慣深化，加上國內經濟成長力道強勁、民間消費熱絡，金管會對全年順利達標持樂觀態度。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) announced today (11th) that the credit card, cash card, and electronic payment business statistics for June 2026 have reached a new high, with a total of NT$7,887 billion in credit card payments, a year-on-year increase of over 100%, and a new record high for a single month.

FSC Vice Chairman Wang Yunzhong pointed out that the tax payment amount of approximately NT$270 billion in June was paid in advance, compared to last year when most tax payments were made in July, resulting in a significant increase in credit card payments in June, with a year-on-year growth rate of 100.33%.

The top five credit card issuers in terms of credit card payments in June were Bank of Taiwan, China Trust, Cathay United Bank, Taiwan New Bank, and Taipei Fubon Bank. Bank of Taiwan's credit card payments reached NT$160.9 billion, a year-on-year increase of 224%, setting a new record high for the bank.

In terms of card issuance and cancellation, Cathay United Bank issued a large number of Cube cards due to the expiration of the Taiwan Plastic Union card contract, resulting in a significant increase in card issuance, reaching 228,000 cards. In contrast, Standard Chartered Bank cancelled a large number of dormant cards, resulting in a significant increase in card cancellations.

As of the end of June this year, there were approximately 59.81 million credit cards in circulation, with approximately 40.11 million valid cards. The total credit card payments for the month were approximately NT$7,887 billion, an increase of approximately NT$3,685 billion from the previous month.

In terms of electronic payments, the total number of users reached 41.13 million, an increase of approximately 360,000 from the previous month. However, due to the end of the Mother's Day holiday and the end of tax payment, the actual transaction amount decreased to NT$29.65 billion, a decrease of NT$22.2 billion from the previous month.

The FSC has set a target for non-cash payments in 2026 of '80 billion transactions and NT$10 trillion in transaction value.' The first half of this year's non-cash payment performance is impressive, with 46.04 billion transactions, a year-on-year increase of 10.07%, and a target achievement rate of 57.55%. The transaction value was NT$5.15 trillion, a year-on-year increase of 26.42%, and a target achievement rate of 51.54%.

Wang Yunzhong analyzed that the high transaction rate is due to the widespread use of small-value transactions. According to the statistics, stored-value cards accounted for only 0.73% of the total non-cash payment transaction value, but accounted for 38.91% of the total transaction count. In contrast, credit cards accounted for 55.82% of the total transaction value and 40.87% of the total transaction count.

Wang Yunzhong expressed optimism about the FSC's target of achieving NT$10 trillion in non-cash payments for the year, citing the growing popularity of electronic payments and credit cards, as well as the strong economic growth and consumer spending in Taiwan.

paras: 根據FactSet最新調查，共12位分析師，對臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)提出目標價估值：中位數由665元下修至640元，調降幅度3.76%。其中最高估值824元，最低估值520元。

paras_en: According to FactSet's latest survey, 12 analysts have set target prices for Zhen Ding-KY (4958-TW): the median value has been lowered from NT$665 to NT$640, a decrease of 3.76%. The highest estimate is NT$824, while the lowest is NT$520.
Overall Rating - A total of 12 analysts have given Zhen Ding-KY (4958-TW) ratings: 12 are optimistic, 1 is neutral, and 0 are conservative.

Zhen Ding-KY (4958-TW) closed at NT$490 on November 11. Over the past 5 days, its stock price has risen by 10.36%, while the related components industry has risen by 10.38%, and the weighted index has risen by 4.06%, with the stock price performing better than the market.
